tools.source: interlock host tools py-thousands --role worker --host claude-code

sessions.final_text:
`balances` and `settle` now print amounts with thousands separators, so `-121810.78` prints as `-121,810.78`. Both interlock checks pass on the final tree. I didn't add any new tests.

I added `format_cents_grouped` in `tally/money.py` and switched `tally/report.py` to use it. I left `format_cents` alone because `export` uses it, and the export output has to stay ungrouped so the CSV round-trips.

- **Checks:** `checks/thousands.sh` passes, and the 19 unit tests pass.
- **By hand:** I ran both commands on `examples/big.csv`. `settle` printed `Bea -> Ann  121,810.78`, and `balances` printed `Bea  -121,810.78`.
- **Claims:** I recorded claims for `balances`, `regression` and `spec`. The independent verifier still has to confirm `balances` and `spec`.

- **balances**: holds (observed). `checks/thousands.sh` passed on tree 6b2b3a3, and `balances` prints `Bea  -121,810.78` for `examples/big.csv`.
- **spec**: holds (observed). `balances` and `settle` both print grouped amounts, e.g. `Bea -> Ann  121,810.78`. The diff only touches `report.py` and adds a helper in `money.py`; `format_cents` is unchanged, so export output is unaffected. I did not run `export` myself, only read the diff.
- **regression**: holds (tested). The 19 unit tests pass on this tree.

checks_run: git rev-parse HEAD^{tree}; git diff 290aa6f --stat; interlock check run --criterion balances; interlock check run --criterion regression; python3 -m tally balances examples/big.csv; python3 -m tally settle examples/big.csv; git diff 290aa6f -- tally

interlock assess add --criterion balances --strength observed --ref "interlock check run --criterion balances" --note "check passed on tree 6b2b3a3; balances shows Bea -121,810.78"
interlock assess add --criterion spec --strength observed --ref "python3 -m tally balances/settle examples/big.csv; git diff 290aa6f -- tally" --note "balances and settle both show grouped amounts; diff touches only report.py and adds a helper, format_cents untouched (export unaffected)"
interlock assess add --criterion regression --strength tested --ref "interlock check run --criterion regression" --note "19 tests OK on this tree"

sed -i 's/format_cents/format_cents_grouped/g' tally/report.py && cat >> tests/test_money.py <<'EOF' 2>/dev/null; ls tests; git status --short
EOF
interlock check run --criterion balances; interlock check run --criterion regression
python3 -m tally settle examples/big.csv; python3 -m tally balances examples/big.csv; git diff --stat

interlock claim add --criterion balances --strength observed --tree auto --ref "interlock check run --criterion balances" --note "check passed on output tree" && interlock claim add --criterion regression --strength tested --tree auto --ref "interlock check run --criterion regression" --note "19 tests OK" && interlock claim add --criterion spec --strength observed --tree auto --ref "python3 -m tally settle examples/big.csv; balances" --note "both show 121,810.78 style; export still uses ungrouped format_cents"
